misprints.note: Färsk, νεβρός, 3. — clearly printed with β; νεβρός means 'fawn'.
'han är f. fältberre' — b clearly printed instead of h; kept as printed (cleaner had changed it to fältherre).
Line-end 'ὀλί-' appears to carry an acute on the iota besides the circumflex on -εῖν.

uncertain.text: μιαίνειν l. μολύνειν ... se d. oo.
uncertain.note: The scan is cut off at the right margin. I supplied the final period of 'l.' and 'oo.' from the book's usual abbreviations ('se d. oo.' occurs 24 times elsewhere).
The breathing on the alpha is small. It looks rough, which is also the correct form, but it could be smooth.
The φ is broken type with its upper loop missing, which is why the old OCR read γρούριον. φ is the certain reading.
The acute on κρηπίς is faint. The circumflex on ῖδος is clear.
The mark on the iota at the line end is small. It may be the top of the italic iota rather than an acute.
